home.about_title: Xinjiang Medical University at a Glance
home.about_lead: Xinjiang Medical University is a comprehensive medical institution offering undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs with a strong focus on clinical practice and research.
home.about_li1: Established legacy in medical education and healthcare training.
home.about_li2: Multi-cultural campus with international students from many countries.
home.about_li3: Collaboration with affiliated hospitals and research centers.
home.news_lead: Stay informed about recent events, announcements and academic highlights from XJMU.
home.news_excerpt1: Xinjiang Medical University launches advanced Cancer Research Center with cutting-edge technology.
home.news_excerpt2: Annual International Medical Conference to be hosted on campus from April 20-22, 2024.
home.news_excerpt3: XJMU ranked among top 10 medical universities in China for clinical research excellence.
home.why_lead: Discover the key advantages that make XJMU a preferred destination for medical education.
home.why1_desc: Extensive clinical exposure in well-equipped teaching hospitals and clinics.
home.why2_desc: Diverse student body with learners from many countries around the world.
home.why3_desc: Strong emphasis on research with access to modern labs and projects.
home.why4_desc: Dedicated support services to help international students settle and succeed.
home.how_lead: Follow these simple steps to start your journey at Xinjiang Medical University.
home.step1: Choose Your Program: Explore MBBS and other programs that match your goals.
home.step2: Check Requirements: Review academic and language requirements for your desired program.
home.step3: Prepare Documents: Collect transcripts, passport copy, medical check-up and other required documents.
home.step4: Submit Application: Apply online or through authorized representatives before the deadline.
home.step5: Receive Offer: On acceptance, complete enrollment and student visa procedures.
home.assistance_desc: Our admissions team is available to guide you at every step of the process, from choosing a program to arriving on campus.

about.history_p1: Founded with the mission to advance medical science and healthcare, Xinjiang Medical University has grown into a comprehensive institution combining teaching, research and clinical practice.
about.history_li1: Long-standing history of training medical professionals for the region and beyond.
about.history_li2: Progressive development of faculties, departments and research institutes.
about.history_li3: Integration of traditional and modern medical education approaches.
about.leadership_p1: XJMU is guided by an experienced leadership team committed to academic quality, innovation and student success.
about.leadership_li1: Strategic vision focused on internationalization and research excellence.
about.leadership_li2: Collaborative governance involving faculty, staff and students.
about.leadership_li3: Strong emphasis on ethical practice and community service.
about.vision_p1: The university's vision is to be a leading center for medical education and research, contributing to regional and global health.
about.vision_li1: Train competent, compassionate and globally-minded healthcare professionals.
about.vision_li2: Advance medical knowledge through research and innovation.
about.vision_li3: Serve the community through high-quality clinical services.

scholarships.lead_desc: Explore various scholarship opportunities to support your education.
scholarships.available_desc: Xinjiang Medical University offers a variety of scholarships to assist students in achieving their educational goals. These scholarships are designed to recognize academic excellence, financial need, and other achievements.
scholarships.row1_eligibility: Outstanding academic performance and recommendation from the university.
scholarships.row1_benefits: Full tuition, accommodation, and monthly stipend.
scholarships.row2_eligibility: International students with excellent grades and financial need.
scholarships.row2_benefits: Partial tuition waiver and living allowance.
scholarships.row3_eligibility: Top-performing students in the previous academic year.
scholarships.row4_eligibility: Proficiency in the Chinese language (HSK Level 4 or above).
scholarships.step1: Check the eligibility criteria for the scholarship you wish to apply for.
scholarships.step2: Prepare the necessary documents, including transcripts, recommendation letters, and personal statements.
scholarships.step3: Submit your application through the official university portal or relevant authority.
scholarships.step4: Await the scholarship committee's decision, which will be communicated via email.
scholarships.contact_desc: If you have any questions regarding scholarships, please feel free to contact the International Student Office at Xinjiang Medical University:

partner.page_title: Why partner with Xinjiang Medical University
partner.p1: Our Partner Program is designed for professional consultants and education organizations who want to support students in starting their medical education journey in China with confidence.
partner.p2: By joining our partner network, you receive structured guidance, regular updates, and a responsive admissions support team. We focus on transparent communication, reliable documentation flow, and student-centered outcomes.
partner.p3: Partners can work with us to explore suitable courses, evaluate applicant profiles, and streamline submissions through a practical collaboration framework aligned with Xinjiang Medical University standards.
partner.highlight1: Structured admissions guidance from inquiry to enrollment
partner.highlight3: Fast response support for consultants and institutions
partner.program_p1: Our mission is to offer a reliable process that helps your team guide students with clarity and professionalism. We provide up-to-date admission requirements, timelines, and program details so your counseling team can operate with confidence.
partner.program_p2: With consistent support and transparent procedures, your organization can improve conversion quality, reduce uncertainty, and deliver a better experience to every applicant.
partner.program_h2: Regular updates on policy and application requirements
partner.program_h3: Practical communication channel with admissions support
partner.program_h4: Long-term partnership model for sustainable growth
partner.wave_title: Still having questions about our partnership programs?
partner.wave_desc: Have questions about the collaboration process? Reach out and our team will guide you through the details and onboarding steps.
partner.form_title: Register as recruitment partner with Xinjiang Medical University
partner.form_sub: Complete this form and submit once. Your registration details will be sent directly to our partnership desk at partners@xjmu.online for review.
